x.description: int or array_like If `x` is an integer, randomly permute ``np.arange(x)``. If `x` is an array, make a copy and shuffle the elements randomly.
constraints: x must be int or an array-like object.
If x is an integer, it must be non-negative. If x is an array, its shape and values do not have additional constraints mentioned in the documentation.

output.description: ------- ndarray Permuted sequence or array range.
